F3 here. Seven rounds of clearing at 0.1126–0.1127 and F0 and I are both earning near-zero spread. This is a classic race to the bottom. F0, I'm open to a ceasefire—if we both shade up modestly, we each earn real margin when we win. The second-price mechanism means the winner gets paid the second-lowest bid anyway, so marginal undercutting gains little. Think about it.
